main_body: A wooden rack frame holding five kegs seen end-on (round keg faces with gold bands) in two tiers, with a wooden top beam/roof band above and a base beam below
top_band: Rows 8-12: orange-brown band (lighter orange at rows 12-13) across the top, but it reads as the front face of a header beam; no distinct horizontal top surface with a front edge line, about 1-2 rows of lighter orange at row 12
evidence: The rack is drawn straight from the front. The top beam (rows 8-13) is a flat band of a similar brown tone to the frame, with only a thin lighter line at row 12 that reads as an edge. The kegs are seen as circular end faces in a face-on view, and the shelf beam between the tiers (row 20-21) and the base beam (rows 29-30) are thin 1-2px lines with no visible top surface. The kegs show no top surfaces. Horizontal beams and base do not show top faces, so this is a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The keg ends have a decent ramp (highlight, mid, dark, gold band) and the outlines are dark brown, tinted to the wood rather than black. The top beam, however, is a large flat band of one orange-brown with almost no grain, and the grey background-like interior areas between the kegs are flat. The wood has no grain or knots. It is thinner than the reference stall and well, which carry per-element highlights and texture.
